title: What AI Benchmarks Actually Measure: Adapting Convergent and Discriminant Validity to Interrogate Fifty-Six AI Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper analyzes and categorizes numerous safety and capability benchmarks, explicitly grouping several datasets under an 'Ethics' category (such as the ETHICS and MoralChoice benchmarks) to assess how models handle moral and ethical beliefs. It also measures bias associated with religion (e.g., using the FtDA-religion dataset).
